findings.summary: Vitest discovers nested delegated worktrees: vitest.config.ts has no include/exclude, so all 6 .ways/worktrees/living-memory/* checkouts (138 nested suites, 535 cases via vitest list) fan out into every run; a targeted 6-file run executed 33 files (119 tests). Main-only runs with --exclude pass; CI fresh clones are unaffected (worktrees are gitignored). Fix by adding include/exclude for .ways/worktrees.

baseline-e2e npm-pack test leaves an untracked tarball in the repo root that enters workDigest and shifts the review digest: digest moved c8576808... to 54c4a22... after the verification run left develatter-latte-ways-0.1.2.tgz (114980 bytes). Tests/baseline-e2e.test.ts runs npm pack in process.cwd() with no cleanup; workDigest hashes all untracked files. Fix by packing in a tmpdir or removing the tarball.
